nodes.text: 5 years after the COVID-19 pandemic, a new virus, HMPV, has emerged in China, spreading rapidly. The human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is affecting several countries, causing a surge in respiratory illnesses.China reports an alarming rise in cases, raising concerns across the region.
